claims.claim_text: Indexed First Lieutenant Walter L. Mess is identified with high confidence as the OSS Maritime Unit veteran documented by the Library of Congress.

claims.temporal_assessment: Identity and wartime-service context; the claim does not by itself identify a pre-OSS employer.
